meta.title: Help
meta.description: Get in touch about a booking, a payment or your Ao Lume account.

page.title: How can we help?
page.lead: Write to us and we usually reply the same working day. If it's about a booking, include the request number: it saves us an email back and forth.

whenDeposit.q: When do I pay the deposit?
whenDeposit.a: Only after the chef accepts your request. You'll get an email with the amount and the deadline, and you pay on the booking page by MB WAY or Multibanco reference.

rest.a: It's agreed and paid directly to the chef. Ao Lume only takes the deposit, and only to secure the booking.

refund.q: The chef cancelled. Do I get my money back?
refund.a: Yes, the deposit is refunded in full. If you paid by MB WAY or card, it goes back the same way; if you paid by Multibanco reference, we ask for your IBAN on your booking page. Never by email or phone.

howToPay.q: When and how do I pay?
howToPay.a: Only after the chef accepts your request. Payment, including any deposit, is arranged directly between you and the chef, using whichever methods they accept. Ao Lume charges clients nothing.

chefCancelled.q: The chef cancelled. What about what I've already paid?
chefCancelled.a: Talk to them through the booking page, where the conversation is kept on record. If you can't reach an agreement, write to us: we'll help sort it out, and it's noted on their Ao Lume account.

ibanScam.q: Someone asked for my IBAN by message. Is that Ao Lume?
ibanScam.a: No. We only ask for bank details inside your booking page, while you're signed in. If you get a request by email, text or phone, don't reply, and let us know at <mail>{email}</mail>.
